caption: The drawing is set on an off-white or yellowed paper and consists of three primary black line diagrams depicting a chair from different views: front view (upper left), top view (upper right), and side view (bottom left). The chair is shown with simple, clean lines, slightly flared back legs, a concave backrest, and a rounded seat with a scalloped edge. Each view includes numerical dimensions printed in fractions, such as “2 1/2”, “3/8”, and “2”, with arrows indicating the measurements' endpoints. The top left of the page has handwritten text in black ink that reads “WORKING DRAWING FOR DOLL CHAIR Actual Size ONE INCH SCALE,” and some red pencil writing along the top edge. The entire drawing is technical in nature, showing precise construction details, spacing, and proportions for the doll chair, including the width and heights of various chair components. The overall drawing is composed in a sparse style, with objects and text organized for clarity and measurement reference.
title: Doll Chair
